source.title: Ensure subtest's context kwargs are JSON serializable

input.diff_text:
diff --git a/src/_pytest/subtests.py b/src/_pytest/subtests.py
--- a/src/_pytest/subtests.py
+++ b/src/_pytest/subtests.py
@@ -61,8 +61,15 @@ class SubtestContext:
     msg: str | None
     kwargs: Mapping[str, Any]
 
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        # Brute-force the returned kwargs dict to be JSON serializable (pytest-dev/pytest-xdist#1273).
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "kwargs", {k: saferepr(v) for (k, v) in self.kwargs.items()}
+        )
+
     def _to_json(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
-        return dataclasses.asdict(self)
+        result = dataclasses.asdict(self)
+        return result
 
     @classmethod
     def _from_json(cls, d: dict[str, Any]) -> Self:

issues.description: SubtestContext now converts every kwargs value to saferepr() at construction time, not only when serializing the report. That fixes JSON serialization for xdist, but it also changes the in-memory public context from original typed values to strings, so plugins or reporters that inspect context.kwargs lose type information.
